notes.title: Version 1.10.0
notes.content:
Version 1.10.0: Moon of Miscria


Moon of Miscria is now live! Head to the Travel Agency now to get access to Gravitron, Mooncrit as well as other brand new Miscrits.



Additionally, this version adds the following changes:



Platinum Arena leaderboard has been reset.

All Time Platinum Arena leaderboard is now live on the website.

Matchmaking for full reliced teams have been restricted to only full reliced teams

You can now view Miscrit stats and Keep/Release right in the battle



Full list of updates can be viewed on the website here.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45568200/9b100bc4dca49163f1e31f95e5f23eb372dc43fd.png"]

notes.title: Version 1.6.0
notes.content:
Version 1.6.0: Hidden Forest


Hidden forest is now live! Capture the OG fan favorite Alpha as well as other exciting new Miscrits.



Other changes and improvements:



Increased XP given from battles by 30%

Increased Platinum Arena cap to 250

Weekly Rewards for top 100 Platinum Arena players



Full list of updates can be found here

notes.title: Version 1.1.0
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45568200/0f24fc544081160c91b0deda177202985bc2817c.png



 Battle UI: Version 1.1.0 refreshes the Battle UI to be more modern and mobile friendly. We understand that players have been using the original UI for a long time and it will take time to get used to the new UI. We hope that you adjust to it quickly!

 Steam, steam and steam! This version adds support for direct registration and login via Steam as well as linking your Steam profile to existing accounts.

 In Game Payments: Much requested IAPs are finally are live for steam users. Players can now purchase Platinum, Gold and Gems through in the in-game shop if playing through Steam.

 Breeding price has been reduced to 3,000 Gold.

 Daily Quests don't enforce winning arena games anymore.



List of past updates and changes can be found on the website here.
